title: Capstone — Service Agreement SA-2025-0847
scenario: A service agreement purportedly worth $240,000 has been manipulated on multiple pages. The candidate must identify all manipulation artifacts without guidance.

all_findings.significance: Document claims MS Word origin but XMP reveals LibreOffice. Info dict was edited after creation.
Payment start date changed from Nov 2025 to Feb 2026 via annotation, three weeks after the contract was executed.

all_findings.cropped_content: Right half of 'ANNEX A - ORIGINAL PAYMENT SCHEDULE: $45,000'

all_findings.significance: $60,000 reduction in professional services fee via content-stream white box.
Photograph claimed to be from London signing ceremony. EXIF GPS reveals Dubai. Capture date (Oct 28) is 13 days after stated contract date (Oct 15).

answer_summary: Five distinct manipulation artifacts across five pages. A complete forensic analysis should report CAP-01 through CAP-05 with supporting evidence from peepdf3/qpdf/mutool and the PDF Forensics application.

exercises.q: List all manipulation findings in this document by type and page.
exercises.a: CAP-01 (p1): Metadata mismatch; CAP-02 (p2): FreeText annotation overlay; CAP-03 (p3): BBOX_CROP; CAP-04 (p4): White-box text overlay; CAP-05 (p5): EXIF GPS anomaly

exercises.q: What is the net financial impact of the manipulations you can identify?
exercises.a: Page 4: $240,000 → $180,000 (fee reduced by $60,000). Page 3: Annex A crops out original $45,000 payment schedule amount. Page 2: First payment delayed from Nov 2025 to Feb 2026.

exercises.q: The photograph on page 5 is claimed to show a London signing ceremony. What evidence contradicts this?
exercises.a: EXIF GPS = Dubai (25.2°N, 55.3°E). EXIF DateTime = Oct 28, not Oct 15. Device = iPhone 15 Pro, not a document scanner.

exercises.q: How would you present CAP-02 (page 2 annotation) in a court exhibit?
exercises.a: Produce: (1) Screenshot of page 2 in normal view showing altered date; (2) annotation object dump from peepdf3 showing /Rect, /Contents, /CreationDate; (3) screenshot of the Visual Overlay Report before/after toggle; (4) extracted version 1 of the PDF showing the original date.
